messages.author: contact
messages.text: Morning! Still on for helping me move on Saturday?

messages.author: user
messages.text: yep, still on. what time?

messages.author: contact
messages.text: The van is booked from 9 to 2

messages.author: user
messages.text: ok. how much stuff are we talking about?

messages.author: contact
messages.text: Mostly boxes, a couch, the bed and my desk

messages.author: user
messages.text: is the desk the huge one?

messages.author: contact
messages.text: Yes... the huge one. Sorry in advance

messages.author: user
messages.text: haha fine. does it come apart?

messages.author: contact
messages.text: The legs come off, I'll do that Friday night

messages.author: user
messages.text: good. is there an elevator at the new place?

messages.author: contact
messages.text: Third floor, no elevator

messages.author: user
messages.text: of course there isn't

messages.author: contact
messages.text: I'm buying lunch for everyone to make up for it

messages.author: user
messages.text: deal. who else is coming?

messages.author: contact
messages.text: My brother and Maya from work

messages.author: user
messages.text: nice, four people should be enough

messages.author: contact
messages.text: I hope so. I've got gloves and straps for the couch

messages.author: user
messages.text: do you need more boxes? I have some in the garage

messages.author: contact
messages.text: That would be great, I'm about 10 short

messages.author: user
messages.text: I'll bring what I have

messages.author: contact
messages.text: You're the best

messages.author: user
messages.text: anything else?

messages.author: contact
messages.text: Two things: can you drive the van? My license expired last month

messages.author: contact
messages.text: And should we start at the old place at 9 or meet at 8:30 for coffee first?
